title: STORM: Benchmarking Visual Rating of MLLMs with a Comprehensive Ordinal Regression Dataset
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the ordinal regression abilities of multi-modal large language models in domains such as image quality, age estimation, and medical grading.
